content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To see a concert, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Purchase digital tickets online (10 minutes)
Step 2. Research local parking garages (15 minutes)
Step 3. Print a physical backup of the ticket (2 minutes)
Step 4. Charge your portable power bank (3 hours)
Step 5. Select a comfortable outfit (10 minutes)
Step 6. Check the venue's bag policy (5 minutes)
Step 7. Find a small clear bag to use (10 minutes)
Step 8. Withdraw cash for merchandise (5 minutes)
Step 9. Post a photo of the stage to social media (1 minute)
Step 10. Put on your shoes (2 minutes)
Step 11. Look up the opening act's discography (20 minutes)
Step 12. Confirm the concert start time on the website (5 minutes)
Step 13. Enter the venue through the security gate (15 minutes)
Step 14. Download the venue's mobile app (5 minutes)
Step 15. Check the weather forecast for the evening (2 minutes)
Step 16. Pack your ID and credit cards (5 minutes)
Step 17. Final mirror check of the outfit (1 minute)
Step 18. Apply sunscreen for the outdoor queue (10 minutes)
Step 19. Set a meeting point for friends (5 minutes)
Step 20. Confirm the ride-share pickup location (2 minutes)
Step 21. Open the ride-share app (1 minute)
Step 22. Style your hair (20 minutes)
Step 23. Take a quick shower (15 minutes)

Step 25. Ask friends if they want to go (1 hour)
Step 26. Check for traffic alerts (5 minutes)
Step 27. Set up a mobile payment wallet (10 minutes)
Step 28. Apply deodorant (1 minute)
Step 29. Decide on a dinner spot near the venue (20 minutes)
Step 30. Find the charging cable (5 minutes)
Step 31. Iron your shirt (10 minutes)
Step 32. Look up the venue address (2 minutes)
Step 33. Drive to the concert venue (45 minutes)
Step 34. Arrange for a pet sitter (2 hours)
Step 35. Double-check that all windows are locked (10 minutes)
Step 36. Eat a light meal (30 minutes)
Step 37. Coordinate the group chat (30 minutes)
Step 38. Sync your smartwatch (5 minutes)
Step 39. Pick out matching accessories (5 minutes)
Step 40. Listen to the headliner's latest album (1 hour)
Step 41. Put your phone in your pocket (30 seconds)
Step 42. Wait for the ride-share to arrive (10 minutes)
Step 43. Verify the date on the ticket (1 minute)
Step 44. Pack a portable rain poncho (5 minutes)
Step 45. Add the digital ticket to your phone wallet (2 minutes)
Step 46. Check your bank balance (2 minutes)
Step 47. Walk from the parking lot to the entrance (15 minutes)
Step 48. Wake up and start the day (1 minute)
Step 49. Grab a pack of gum (30 seconds)
Step 50. Find your assigned seats (10 minutes)
Step 51. Buy a souvenir t-shirt (15 minutes)
Step 52. Check the setlist online (10 minutes)
Step 53. Fill a reusable water bottle (2 minutes)
Step 54. Put the cash in your wallet (1 minute)
Step 55. Brush your teeth (3 minutes)
Step 56. Locate the rain poncho in the closet (5 minutes)
Step 57. Charge your smartphone to 100% (2 hours)
Step 58. Hand the ticket to the usher (30 seconds)
Step 59. Meet up with the rest of the group (15 minutes)
Step 60. Clear your schedule for the evening (1 hour)
